name: ui
description: A flexible UI library for modern web development.

scripts.dev:docs: concurrently --names "CORE,DOCS" --prefix-colors "gray,white" "pnpm run dev:core" "pnpm --filter docs run dev"
scripts.release:core:patch: pnpm run build:core && npm version patch -w @fefade-ui/core --no-git-tag-version && git add packages/core && git commit -m "chore(release): bump version core" && git tag core-v$(node -p "require('./packages/core/package.json').version") && pnpm run git:push
scripts.release:svelte:patch: pnpm run build:svelte && npm version patch -w @fefade-ui/svelte --no-git-tag-version && git add packages/svelte && git commit -m "chore(release): bump version svelte" && git tag svelte-v$(node -p "require('./packages/svelte/package.json').version") && pnpm run git:push
scripts.release:react:patch: pnpm run build:react && npm version patch -w @fefade-ui/react --no-git-tag-version && git add packages/react && git commit -m "chore(release): bump version react" && git tag react-v$(node -p "require('./packages/react/package.json').version") && pnpm run git:push
scripts.release:vue:patch: pnpm run build:vue && npm version patch -w @fefade-ui/vue --no-git-tag-version && git add packages/vue && git commit -m "chore(release): bump version vue" && git tag vue-v$(node -p "require('./packages/vue/package.json').version") && pnpm run git:push
scripts.release:core:tag: pnpm run build:core && git tag core-v$(node -p "require('./packages/core/package.json').version") && git push origin core-v$(node -p "require('./packages/core/package.json').version")
scripts.release:svelte:tag: pnpm run build:svelte && git tag svelte-v$(node -p "require('./packages/svelte/package.json').version") && git push origin svelte-v$(node -p "require('./packages/svelte/package.json').version")
scripts.release:react:tag: pnpm run build:react && git tag react-v$(node -p "require('./packages/react/package.json').version") && git push origin react-v$(node -p "require('./packages/react/package.json').version")
scripts.release:vue:tag: pnpm run build:vue && git tag vue-v$(node -p "require('./packages/vue/package.json').version") && git push origin vue-v$(node -p "require('./packages/vue/package.json').version")
scripts.clean: pnpm run clean:modules && pnpm run clean:lock && pnpm clean:build
